evidence_boundary.proves: That Lumentum management issued FY27 Q1 net revenue guidance of $1.225B–$1.275B in a primary SEC-filed earnings release (rev_3b8246f3c0ae4ae8ba98afbd6d8eae1c, rev_15b8a51a64b6417eb355974725fc6b1d), and that FY26 Q4 actual revenue was $1.0063B (rev_14bb0d25bc0a4d57996ac830e7042d86, rev_ab1965f3cdb44c1bb501d023787a61b1). The arithmetic implication of sequential growth is therefore established.
evidence_boundary.does_not_prove: That the guidance will be achieved, that the growth is driven by Datacom/Cloud demand specifically, that the upcycle is durable beyond Q1 FY27, or that the guidance reflects anything other than management's own internal plan. No independent (non-issuer) confirmation of the guidance or of end-demand exists in the evidence set.

Guidance is achievable but the sequential acceleration is already fully reflected in consensus/price, so it carries limited incremental signal.

what_weakens: A guidance revision downward before the FY27 Q1 report.
